> **Moved.** The prompt engineering guide lives at
> [`agents/templates/PROMPT_ENGINEERING_GUIDE.md`](../../agents/templates/PROMPT_ENGINEERING_GUIDE.md).

This file was a byte-identical copy of it, and that is why it is now a pointer
rather than a document.

The copy was made when both were correct, and stayed behind when the canonical
one was reconciled against the typed output contract, the sketch compiler and
runtime grounding enforcement. Nothing in the repo linked here — every
reference (`docs/AGENT_MODEL.md`, `docs/OPEN_DESIGN_QUESTIONS.md`,
`docs/COMPOSITION_AS_FIRST_CLASS.md`) already names the `agents/templates`
path — so the only way to arrive at this file was to find it by browsing, and
what you would have found is authoring advice that now costs an agent every one
of its tools. A stale twin nobody links to is worse than no copy: it looks
current, it has no reader who would notice it is not, and it is the same
two-copies-of-one-decision drift the guide itself is mostly about.
